Rashi on Nedarim 48b:1:1.hebrew: כיפי דכיתנא - שהיה גוזל אניצי פשתן, ואית דאמרי שהיה משמט עצמו מללמוד תורה והיה עוסק באניצי פשתן:
Rashi on Nedarim 48b:1:1.english: Sheaves of flax - That he used to steal bundles of flax, and some say that he would withdraw himself from studying Torah and occupy himself with bundles of flax.

Rashi on Nedarim 48b:1:2.hebrew: ואי הוה בר ברך צורבא מרבנן מאי - כלומר, מה יהיה ומי יורש נכסיך:
Rashi on Nedarim 48b:1:2.english: And if your son's son were a Torah scholar, what [then] - That is to say, what will be, and who will inherit your possessions?

Rashi on Nedarim 48b:1:3.hebrew: ליקני הדין דאי הוי בר בריה צורבא מרבנן וכו' - משום דאכתי לא הוי בר בריה בעולם, והוה ליה מזכה לעובר, והמזכה לעובר לא קנה:
Rashi on Nedarim 48b:1:3.english: Let this [son] acquire [them], that if his grandson becomes a Torah scholar, etc. - Because his grandson is not yet in the world, and he is [like] one who conveys title to an unborn fetus, and [when] one conveys title to an unborn fetus, [the fetus] does not acquire [it].

Rashi on Nedarim 48b:2:1.hebrew: קני על מגת להקנות הוא - דברא בנכסי אביו לא צריך קנין, הלכך מקני ליה לבריה אדעתא לאקנויי לבר בריה היא:
Rashi on Nedarim 48b:2:1.english: It is "Acquire on the condition that you transfer [ownership]" - Because a son does not require an act of acquisition for his father's property; therefore, it is [a case where] he transfers ownership to his son with the intent [for him] to transfer [it] to his grandson.

Rashi on Nedarim 48b:2:2.english: And any [case] of "acquire on the condition to transfer" - [It] is not an acquisition.

Rashi on Nedarim 48b:3:1.hebrew: דהא סודרא קני על מנת להקנות הוא - דהא לא מקני נותן למקנה כליו של קונה, והא מקני ליה לדידיה דקא מקני ליה לההוא חפץ לקונה. הכא נמי, כי אמר על מנת להקנות, קני:
Rashi on Nedarim 48b:3:1.english: For [acquisition by means of] a cloth is [a case of] "acquiring in order to transfer" - For the giver does not transfer the buyer's utensil to the transferor [permanently]; rather, he transfers it to him [only] so that he transfers that object to the buyer. Here too, when he says "in order to transfer," he acquires [it].

Rashi on Nedarim 48b:4:1.hebrew: אי תפים ליה לא מתפיס - בתמיה, דאי בעי מקנה למישקל בכנפא דסודרא ולמיקניה למישקליה לדידיה, ליכא מאן דמחי ליה:
Rashi on Nedarim 48b:4:1.english: If he seizes it, is it not seized? - [This is asked] as a rhetorical question: for if the transferor wants to take the corner of the cloth and acquire it to take it for himself, there is no one who can protest against him.

Rashi on Nedarim 48b:4:2.hebrew: ועוד סודרא - לא דמי לההיא כלל, דאילו גבי סודרא, כי תפיס ליה משמע דהכי אמר ליה: קני השתא בשעת קנין על מנת להקנות, וקני השתא הסודר, ומקני ליה בשעת קנין החפץ. אבל קני נכסי דהדין, לאימת קא קני להו? לכי הוי בר בריה צורבא מרבנן. הלכך, השתא נמי לא קני, ואסור לקנות להן, ובן בנו נמי לא קנה, ואי בעי אביו, יהיב ליה לנכסיה ולכל ' מאן דבעי:
Rashi on Nedarim 48b:4:2.english: And furthermore, a cloth - It is not comparable to that [case] at all: for regarding a cloth, when he seizes it, it implies that [the giver] said to him thus: "Acquire [it] now, at the time of the act of acquisition, on condition to transfer [ownership]," and he acquires the cloth now, and transfers the object to him at the time of the act of acquisition. However, [as for] acquiring the possessions of this [man], when does he acquire them? When his son's son becomes a Torah scholar. Therefore, now too he does not acquire [them], and it is forbidden to acquire them, and his son's son also has not acquired [them], and if his father wishes, he may give his possessions to him or to anyone he wishes.

Rashi on Nedarim 48b:5:1.hebrew: והא מתנת בית חורון דקני על מנת להקנות הוא ולא קני זימנין אמר ליה וכו' - דהתם היינו טעמא דלא קני, דסעודתו מוכחת עליו, דודאי לא יהיב ליה אלא משום סעודה, ואסור הואיל ומחזי דמיתהני מיניה. הכא נמי, כיון דקא בעי דיאכל אבא, לא קנה אידך, משום דקא מתהני אביו מיניה, ואהכי אסור:
Rashi on Nedarim 48b:5:1.english: But the gift of Beit Choron is [an acquisition] in order to transfer [ownership], and he did not acquire [it]; sometimes he said to him, etc. - For there, this is the reason that he did not acquire [it]: because his feast proves about him that he certainly only gave it to him for the sake of the feast, and it is forbidden since it appears that he is deriving benefit from him. Here too, since he wants that "Father should eat," the other [person] did not acquire [it], because his father is deriving benefit from him, and therefore it is forbidden.

Rashi on Nedarim 48b:7:1.hebrew: לאו לאתויי הא מילתא דשריא בכפילה - כלומר, האי מעשה שמוטל בתנאי כפול, דכפל לדיבוריה דאמר: ליקני הדין, ואי הוי בר בריה צורבא מרבנן ליקנייה לבריה, דודאי לא קנה. ואית דגרסי: מאי לאו לאתויי הא מילתא דשמיט בכיפי — מילתא דבית חורון, דדמיא לאותו מעשה דכיפי דכתנא:
Rashi on Nedarim 48b:7:1.english: Is it not to include this matter that rests upon a double [condition] - That is to say, this incident that is cast with a double condition, for he doubled his statement when he said: "Let this one acquire [the property], and if his son's son is a Torah scholar, let him transfer it to his son" — [teaching] that he certainly does not acquire [it]. And there are those who have the reading: "What, is it not to include this matter of one who snatches sheaves?" — [referring to] the matter of Beit Horon, which resembles that incident of the sheaves of flax.

Rashi on Nedarim 48b:7:2.hebrew: לא לאיתויי לישנא בתרא דשמעתיה דרבא - דאמר לעיל אפי' א"ל, והן לפניך שיבא אבא ויאכל, דאסור. אבל היכא דא"ל, ליקני הדין דאי הוי בר בריה צורבא מרבנן לקנייה, קני על מנת להקנות הוא:
Rashi on Nedarim 48b:7:2.english: No, [it comes] to include the latter version of Rava's statement - For he said above [that] even if he said to him, "And they are before you so that [my] father may come and eat," it is forbidden. However, where he said to him, "Let this one acquire [it], so that if his grandson is a rabbinic scholar he shall acquire it," it is [a case of] "acquire on condition to transfer ownership" [and is valid].

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:1:1.english: "Who was snatching sheaves of flax" - He would snatch bundles of flax and ruin them.

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:1:2.english: He prohibited his possessions - He forbade him by a vow that he should not derive benefit from his possessions, [neither] in his lifetime nor after his death.

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:1:3.hebrew: אמרו לו - לאביו, למה אסרת בנך אחר מותך:
Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:1:3.english: They said to him - to his father: Why did you prohibit your son [from your possessions] after your death?

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:1:4.hebrew: אמר ליה ליקני הדין דאי הוה ברי' צורבא מרבנן ליקני - כלומר, יקנה נכסי' הללו, שאם יהיה בנו צורבא מרבנן, יקנה אותם לו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:1:4.english: He said to him: Let this [person] acquire [them], so that if his son is a Torah scholar, let him acquire [them] - That is to say, [this person] shall acquire these possessions, so that if his [the giver's] son becomes a Torah scholar, he shall transfer them to him.

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:2:1.hebrew: קנה על מנת להקנות הוא - שהבן קונה לעצמו כדי להקנות לבנו, ולא הוי כשאר זוכים בשביל חביריהם ומועיל, דכל עיקר הזכייה אינה בשביל עצמו, כי אם בשביל חבירו המקבל המתנה; אבל הכא אמר ליה: "קנה כדי שתקנה לבנך כשיהיה צורבא מרבנן", וגם לעצמו לא נגמרה המתנה. ולא הויא לה כמתנה על מנת להחזיר, דמסיק בקידושין (דף ו:) דמקנה בה קרקע לנותן; דהתם נגמר המכירה כשאמר ליה: "הריני נותן לך דבר זה על מנת להחזיר, ובכסף זה תקנה לי שדי", אבל הכא מפרש בהדיא שאינו מקנה לו אלא ע"מ להקנות:
Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:2:1.english: It is "Acquire on the condition that you transfer" - That the son acquires [the property] for himself in order to transfer [it] to his son. And this is not like other [cases where people] acquire on behalf of their fellows and it is effective, for [in those cases] the entire acquisition is not for himself, but rather for his fellow, the recipient of the gift; here, however, he said to him: "Acquire [it] in order that you transfer [it] to your son when he becomes a Torah scholar," and even for himself the gift was not finalized. And it is not like a gift [given] on the condition to return [it], regarding which [the Gemara] concludes in Kiddushin (6b) that one can transfer land through it to the giver; for there the sale is finalized when he says to him: "Behold, I am giving you this item on the condition to return [it], and with this money you shall transfer my field to me," whereas here he states explicitly that he is transferring [it] to him only on the condition to transfer [it to another].

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:3:1.hebrew: ורב נחמן אמר קני - (והכא קני) ואע"ג דהשתא אין הבן בעולם, ולא מחלק בין בא לעולם ובין לא בא לעולם, ובין שמקנה לבן עצמו כדי להקנות לבנו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:3:1.english: And Rav Nachman said: He acquires - (And here he acquires) and even though right now the son is not in the world, [Rav Nachman] does not distinguish between [whether he has] come into the world and [whether he has] not come into the world, nor between [whether] he transfers [the property] to the son himself in order to transfer [it] to his son [or to someone else].

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:3:2.english: "For a cloth" - with which one acquires through chalipin [symbolic exchange].

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:3:3.hebrew: קנה על מנת להקנות הוא - כלומר, ורגילות הוא שהוא מחזיר לו הסודר, ויודע הוא שלא יתקיים בידו, וקני ליה — שהרי יודע שמקנה הוא לו ע"י הקנין החפץ שלו. וכמו כן [הכא על מנת] להקנות הוא; אע"פ שלא תתקיים מתנה בידו, קנה שפיר ויקנה אותה לבן:
Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:3:3.english: He acquires [it] in order to transfer [ownership] - That is to say, it is customary that he returns the cloth to him, and he knows that it will not remain in his possession, yet he acquires it — for he knows that he is transferring his object to him by means of the act of acquisition. And similarly, [here too it is in order] to transfer [ownership]; even though the gift will not remain in his possession, he acquires [it] properly and will transfer it to the son.

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:4:1.hebrew: ומאן לימא לן דהך סודרא אי תפיס ליה לא מתפיס - כלומר, מאן לימא לן דאי בעי לא פסיק ליה? דילמא ודאי אי בעי פסיק ליה, ומתנה מעליא היא. (אבל) [ועוד] קני ע"מ להקנות — ליכא לדמויי לסודרא, דבסודרא קני על מנת להקנות מהשתא הוא, דבשעה שמקנה לו הסודר אמר לו שיקנה לו בחליפין מיד. ה"נ שמעינן מינה: אם אמר להקנות מיד בשעת הקנאה — קני:
Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:4:1.english: "And who will say to us concerning this cloth that if [the recipient] seizes it, it is not an effective seizure?" - That is to say: who will say to us that if he wants, he does not take it? Perhaps indeed if he wants, he takes it, and [thus] it is a valid gift. And furthermore: [regarding] "acquire in order to transfer" — one cannot compare [the present case] to a cloth, for with a cloth it is "acquire in order to transfer from now," since at the time that he transfers the cloth to him, he tells him that he should acquire through chalifin [symbolic exchange] immediately. So too we learn from this: if one said to transfer immediately at the time of the act of acquisition, he acquires [it].

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:4:2.hebrew: הלין נכסים לאימת קני לכי הוי צורבא מרבנן כבר הדרא סודרא למריה - ולאו דווקא סודרא, ונראה דרב אשי סבירא ליה כפומבדיתאי, דקני ע"מ להקנות לשון גרוע הוא, ולא גמר להקנות לו כלל, ולא נגמרה המתנה כלל; ולא דמי לסודר שנותנו בידו להיות קונה בו מיד, אבל כשיש תרתי לריעותא — שאין המתנה נגמרה לו וגם אחר זמן — לאו קנייה הוא. ומטעם זה נראה דאפי' אם נתן לו שטר ואמר לו: קנה בשטר זה ע"מ שתקנה בו לבנו, והשטר קיים בימי הבן — לאו קנייה הוא כסברא דפומבדיתאי. והאי דקאמר הדרא סודרא למריה לאו דוקא, אלא כלומר: קניין שאינו גמור אינו מועיל להקנות בו לאחר זמן, ולא דמי לסודר שקנה בו מיד. - ובלא שמעתין אור"י, שאין אדם יכול להקנות חפץ לחבירו מעכשיו לאחר שלשים יום, דההיא שעתא דחל הקניין הדרא סודרא למריה, כי ההיא דנתקרע או שאבד למאן דאמר לכשתתן; וכן "משוך פרה זו ולא תהא קנוייה לך אלא לאחר שלשים יום", דאם אינה עומדת באגם לא קנה, דנתבטלה המשיכה. ומיהו אם הקנה לו מעכשיו ע"מ שארצה לאחר ל', ודאי נגמרה המתנה מיד קודם החזרת הסודר:
Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:4:2.english: "These possessions, when does [the son] acquire [them]? When [his son's son] becomes a Torah scholar, the cloth has already returned to its owner" - And [this is] not specifically [regarding] a cloth. Rather, it appears that Rav Ashi holds like the Pumbeditai, that "Acquire in order to transfer" is a defective expression, and he did not resolve to transfer [ownership] to him at all, and the gift was not completed at all; and it is not similar to a cloth that one places in his hand so that he acquires with it immediately, whereas when there are two disadvantages — that the gift is not completed for him and also [takes effect only] after a time — it is not a [valid] acquisition. And for this reason, it appears that even if he gave him a document and said to him: "Acquire with this document in order that you transfer [ownership] with it to his son," and the document still exists in the days of the son — it is not a [valid] acquisition, according to the view of the Pumbeditai. And that which [the Gemara] says, "the cloth has returned to its owner," is not meant literally; rather, it means to say: an incomplete acquisition is not effective to transfer [ownership] with it after a time, and it is not similar to a cloth with which one acquires immediately. - And even apart from our discussion, Rabbeinu Yitzchak says that a person cannot transfer an object to his fellow "from now, [to take effect] after thirty days," for at that moment when the acquisition takes effect, the cloth has [already] returned to its owner, like that case of "[if the betrothal money] tore or was lost," according to the one who says "[it takes effect] when you give [it]"; and similarly, "Pull this cow, and let it not be acquired by you until after thirty days," where if it is not standing in the meadow [at that time], he has not acquired [it], because the [act of] pulling has been nullified. However, if he transferred [it] to him "from now, on condition that I am willing after thirty [days]," certainly the gift is completed immediately, prior to the return of the cloth:

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:5:1.hebrew: והרי מתנת בית חורון דקני ע"מ להקנות ולא קני - דמקני לו החצר והסעודה להקנות לאביו, דלא קנה; דאי קנאה, א"כ קנאה המקבל ובהיתר מקנה לה לאביו, וא"כ אמאי אסרו? ומשני: משום דסעודתו מוכיח עליו שלא היה רוצה שיקנה כלל כ"א בשביל שיסעוד אביו, וא"כ אין דעתו להקנות כלל למקבל כ"א לאביו. וכי נמי קנה ע"מ להקנות קני בעלמא — משום דמקנה שפיר למקבל, אך המקבל יקנה אותה לאחר; אבל הכא אין דעתו להקנות כלל למקבל כ"א לאביו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:5:1.english: "But the gift of Beit Ḥoron, which is [a case of] 'acquire in order to transfer,' and he did not acquire [it]" - [That is,] where he transfers to him the courtyard and the feast in order to transfer [them] to his father, where he did not acquire [it]; for if he had acquired it, then the recipient would have acquired it and would permissibly transfer it to his father — and if so, why did they prohibit [it]? And [the Gemara] answers: Because his feast proves about him that he did not want him to acquire [it] at all, except so that his father would dine [there], and therefore his intention is not to transfer [it] to the recipient at all, but rather to his father. And even when "acquire in order to transfer" does acquire in general — [that is] because he properly transfers [it] to the recipient, [with the understanding] that the recipient will transfer it to another; however, here his intention is not to transfer [it] to the recipient at all, but rather to his father.

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:6:1.hebrew: וזימנין א"ל ר"א היא - דמחמיר במודר הנאה; הלכך כי נמי קני ע"מ להקנות קני, הכא לא קני להחמיר:
Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:6:1.english: And sometimes he said to him: It is Rabbi Eliezer - For he is stringent regarding one prohibited by a vow from deriving benefit; therefore, even though [one who acquires] on condition to transfer ownership acquires, here he does not acquire, [so as] to be stringent.

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:7:1.hebrew: לאיתויי מאי לאו לאיתויי הא מילתא דשמיט כיפי - כלומר ע"מ להקנות. ואור"ת גירסא: "דשדייה בכפילא" — פירוש: לשון המושלך בכפילות, שכפל דבריו וחזר ואמר: "אי הוה בר בריה צורבא מרבנן, ליקני ע"מ להקנות":
Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:7:1.english: "What does it come to include? Is it not to include this matter of one who seized sheaves?" - That is to say, [the case of acquiring] on condition to transfer ownership. And Rabbeinu Tam cites a [variant] reading: deshadyei bekhafila — explanation: an expression cast in doubled language, for he repeated his words and said again: "If his son's son is a Torah scholar, let him acquire [it] on condition to transfer ownership."

Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:7:2.hebrew: לאיתויי לישנא בתרא דרבא - אי אמר "והם לפניך", אסור:
Tosafot on Nedarim 48b:7:2.english: To include the latter version of Rava['s statement] - If he said, "And they are before you," it is forbidden:
